Name: Ahihud, Son of Gera
Summary: Son of Gera, begotten after the removal to Manahath.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:7: Son of Gera, begotten after the removal to Manahath.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ahihud stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
